title: Academy portal container access
description: Learn how to locate a known Academy workload and open its container terminal.
completionText: Lesson complete: the Academy database pod terminal is open.

steps.title: Open Workloads
steps.description: Expand Workloads in the navigation. Workload resources such as Pods are grouped here so operators can inspect running application components.

steps.title: Open Pods
steps.description: Select Pods to see the workload instances running in the current project. The project is already scoped to dcs-academy-portal.

steps.title: Open the Academy database pod
steps.description: Open dcs-academy-portal-db-1. A pod details page brings status, configuration, logs, events, and container access together.

steps.title: Inspect the logs
steps.description: Open Logs before connecting to the container. Logs are normally the safest first source of evidence when diagnosing a running workload.

steps.title: Open the container terminal
steps.description: Open Terminal to start an interactive session in the selected pod. In real environments, use terminal access carefully and prefer read-only inspection commands.
